 About Huzzle
 At Huzzle, we connect exceptional global talent with leading companies across the UK, US, Europe, Canada, and the Middle East. Our clients range from fast-growing startups to enterprise technology companies operating in SaaS, AI, FinTech, cybersecurity, and cloud infrastructure.
 Unlike traditional outsourcing agencies, professionals hired through Huzzle work directly with international clients as long-term, in-house team members contributing to mission-critical projects and infrastructure.
 Job Summary
 We are seeking an experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to lead infrastructure automation, cloud platform reliability, and deployment scalability initiatives for international technology companies.
 This role is ideal for someone with deep expertise in Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD automation, and platform engineering who thrives in fast-paced engineering environments and enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges at scale.
 You will collaborate closely with software engineers, security teams, and product stakeholders to improve deployment workflows, optimize infrastructure performance, and maintain highly available cloud-native systems.
 Key Responsibilities
Architect, implement, and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure environments
Design and optimize CI/CD pipelines for high-frequency deployments
Manage Kubernetes clusters and container orchestration environments
Build Infrastructure-as-Code solutions using Terraform and automation best practices
Improve platform reliability, scalability, and system observability
Monitor production systems using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, or similar tools
Implement security, backup, and disaster recovery best practices
Troubleshoot infrastructure, networking, and deployment issues across environments
Collaborate with engineering teams on release management and platform optimization
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to DevOps best practices across the organization
 Requirements
5+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Platform Engineering, or Cloud Infrastructure roles
Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Linux, and cloud-native technologies
Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform
Strong expertise in Terraform and Infrastructure-as-Code methodologies
Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or ArgoCD
Strong scripting or programming experience using Python, Go, Bash, or JavaScript
Knowledge of networking, security, distributed systems, and cloud architecture principles
Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, or ELK Stack
Excellent communication skills and ability to work independently in remote environments
 Nice to Have
Experience with GitOps workflows and ArgoCD
Exposure to AI infrastructure or large-scale distributed systems
Experience supporting enterprise SaaS platforms
Certifications in AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, or Terraform
Open-source contributions or technical blogging experience
 Benefits
 Competitive salary based on experience and technical expertise.
 Fully remote opportunity with global engineering teams.
 Work on modern cloud-native infrastructure and large-scale systems.
 Long-term career progression opportunities into Lead or Principal Engineering roles.
 Access to cutting-edge DevOps, Kubernetes, and automation technologies.
 Collaborative engineering culture with high-impact technical ownership.
 Flexible work environment focused on autonomy and performance.
